mars/mouth/remesh-attempt-3.label: D_native_data_transfer_VISUAL_FAIL
mars/mouth/remesh-attempt-3.note: VISUAL_FAIL #3, and two named bugs of mine. (1) His MOUTH IS SHUT in a jaw-30 pose -- my mode-D swap removes and re-adds the object's vertex groups AFTER the transfer wrote the weights, and removing a group destroys the weights in the mesh's deform layer, so the armature drives nothing. The test was not even valid. (2) The whole head is covered in scrambled triangular texture -- POLYINTERP_NEAREST resampled UVs across ALL 34,147 verts including the 27,536 survivors that already had correct UVs, and it cannot reproduce a UV seam. NOT PROMOTED.
